g.text: client_id : uuid «unique» (the phone's own name for it: a retry is the same message)
deleted_at : timestamptz (unsent: the row stays, the words go)
media_id : bigint «FK → chat_media, SET NULL» (the picture, or a sticker)
poster_key : text (the small JPEG: thumbnail, or a frame)
sticker : boolean (in the tray, for both)
delivered_id : bigint (reached one of their devices, up to here)
read_id : bigint (was on their screen, up to here; read implies delivered)
Two watermarks per person, not a row per message:
"seen" under my last message is their read_id
having passed it. Forward only, never past
